title: Real Conditions in Context
objectives: Use real conditions in context accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use first conditional in emails, negotiations, and plans.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about real conditions in context. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use real conditions in context?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Professional: If we receive payment, we will ship Monday.

Mix with when for scheduled conditions.

grammar.title: Real Conditions in Context
grammar.rule: Professional: If we receive payment, we will ship Monday.

reading.title: Real Conditions in Context in Context
reading.text: If we receive the signed contract today, we will start onboarding tomorrow. When the payment clears, you will get access. If costs rise, we will need to renegotiate.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using real conditions in context. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: When we receive approval… If they approve the budget… We can negotiate if… Meet the deadline.

tutorHints: Target structure: Real Conditions in Context.
Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
